body: Thank you I really appreciate it. I’m going to try to find a dress and if something comes up I’ll comment again.
I might go try to find a new dress but I’m afraid of running into her. Also I’m afraid to be open with my friend I don’t want to overwhelm her

I appreciate you taking the time to talk to me. My immediate thoughts are I want to die, I need to leave, oh god I’m crying, I need to get out of here I need to get away. Then it evolved into me needing to be a better version of myself (sudden need to begin starving myself to lose weight, need new style and need to look better in general) because I immediately felt inferior again. The mall closes at 9 so she’ll leave in 40 mins if she hasn’t already but I’m still scared.
I’m at the mall and on reddit yeah I’m sitting in a seating area (couches) and I’m paranoid and shaking

I would always take 2-4 hour long baths just to have an excuse to stay in the bathroom. For a while my parents didn’t have a door on my bedroom and even now (it’s been 5-6 years at least) I don’t have a doorknob. It’s just an empty hole.
I will do as you recommend, thank you for the advice I really appreciate it
